user_saw: Changing Visitor Access limits during an active agent turn could leave the update pending, make the Gateway report itself unready, and delay new runs.
summary: The fix applies Visitor Access limit changes in place from committed configuration and checks that newly prepared turns can safely borrow the running service.
reasoning: The original Visitor Access plugin captured its limits at registration and documented a Gateway restart for configuration changes. I checked that the Gateway already drained retained work before exclusive replacement when #159410 made agent turns retain the Gateway-owned visitor tool instance, tying limit edits to the lifetime of those turns. The later instance-borrowing change preserved that drain behavior, and the fix lets numeric edits bypass replacement.
